title_en: Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation 44th Scholars: Recommendation for the 2027 Academic Year
summary: Students who will advance to the first semester of their second year in Spring 2027, are in student aid income bracket 3 or lower, and have a cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.3 or higher may apply for recommendation to the Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation's 44th scholarship cohort. Applicants must complete the recommendation list form (Attachment 3) and email it to the department office by 17:00 on Friday, 13 November 2026. Final candidates must submit the required documents by email to the department office by 17:00 on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, and attend the foundation interview on Saturday, 19 December 2026.
applies_to: Voluntary application, open only to students who meet all of the following: (1) will advance to the first semester of their second year as of the first semester of 2027 (Spring 2027); (2) are in student aid income bracket (학자금지원구간) 3 or lower; (3) have a cumulative GPA for all semesters of 3.0/4.3 or higher; (4) will participate faithfully in the foundation's official events and can adapt to community living. Each department may recommend at most 1 student; the College of Engineering plans to recommend 2 students.

conditions: Each department may recommend at most 1 student; the College of Engineering plans to recommend 2 students.
The scholarship is 5,000,000 KRW per semester and continues until graduation within the regular semesters only if the foundation's requirements continue to be met.
This scholarship cannot be received at the same time as other off-campus or donated scholarships.
If more than 2 eligible students apply in the College of Engineering, candidates are ranked by a combined score of income bracket and cumulative GPA.
Ties are broken by income bracket, then previous-semester GPA, then credits completed in the previous semester.
The scholarship application and self-introduction must include the department head's official seal (직인).
The resident registration abstract must be issued with the last digits of the resident registration number hidden.
The certificate of basic livelihood recipient or near-poverty status is required only from students to whom it applies.
Candidates who do not attend the interview are automatically eliminated.
Being recommended by the College of Engineering does not guarantee final selection as a scholar.
steps: Read the foundation's official letter and notice (Attachments 1-1 and 1-2) and the forms (Attachments 2-1, 2-2 and 2); their contents were not read for this translation.
Complete the recommendation list form (Attachment 3, 장학생 추천명단.xlsx) and email it to the department office by 17:00 on Friday, 13 November 2026 (the email address is in the original notice).
Check with the department whether you have been selected as a final recommended candidate; departments are notified at 11:00 on Tuesday, 17 November 2026.

If selected as a final candidate: email one copy each of the following to the department office by 17:00 on Wednesday, 18 November 2026: scholarship application and self-introduction (with the department head's official seal), student aid income bracket notice, student record card, academic transcript, resident registration abstract (last digits of the resident registration number hidden), consent forms for collection, use and provision of personal information (for the foundation and for the university), and, only if applicable, a certificate of basic livelihood recipient or near-poverty status.
If selected as a final candidate: attend the interview on Saturday, 19 December 2026, 09:00 to 12:00 (scheduled), in the foundation's main conference room; absence means automatic elimination.
translation:
The Songwon Kim Young-hwan Scholarship Foundation announces the selection of its 44th cohort of scholars for the 2027 academic year as follows.

A. Number of recommendations: at most 1 per department. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend 2 students.

B. Recommendation (eligibility) requirements
1) Students who will advance to the first semester of their second year as of the first semester of 2027 (27-1학기)
2) Student aid income bracket (학자금지원구간) 3 or lower, and a cumulative GPA for all semesters of 3.0/4.3 or higher
3) Students who will participate faithfully in the foundation's official events and are able to adapt to community living

C. Scholarship amount: 5,000,000 KRW per semester (supported until graduation within the regular semesters if the foundation's requirements are met). ※ Cannot be received concurrently with other off-campus or donated scholarships.

D. Selection procedure
1) Departmental recommendation and application deadline/method: complete the recommendation list [Attachment 3] and send it by email to the department office by 17:00 on Friday, 13 November 2026 (the email address is given in the original notice).
※ If applications exceed the College of Engineering's recommendation quota (2 students), applicants who meet the basic eligibility requirements will be evaluated by the combined score of income bracket and cumulative GPA. In case of a tie, candidates will be selected by income bracket, then previous-semester GPA, then credits completed in the previous semester, in that order.
2) Notification of final recommended candidates to departments: 11:00 on Tuesday, 17 November 2026
3) Document submission by final recommended candidates: by 17:00 on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, submit one copy each of the following by email to the department office: scholarship application and self-introduction (including the department head's official seal (직인)), student aid income bracket notice (학자금지원구간통지서), student record card (학생카드), academic transcript, resident registration abstract (주민등록등본, issued with the last digits of the resident registration number hidden), consent forms for the collection, use and provision of personal information (for the foundation and for the university), and a certificate of basic livelihood recipient or near-poverty (차상위계층) status (applicable students only).

E. Other matters
1) All recommended candidates must check the interview schedule.
- Interview: Saturday, 19 December 2026, 09:00 to 12:00 (scheduled), foundation main conference room. ※ Absence results in automatic elimination.
2) Please note in advance that students recommended by the College of Engineering may not be finally selected as scholars.

Attachments
1. Foundation official letter and notice, 1 copy each.
2. Forms for required documents, 1 copy each.
3. Recommendation list, 1 copy.

Consent form for collection, use and third-party provision of personal information (.docx); 2-2. Consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information (Scholarship and Welfare Division, off-campus foundations) (.hwp); 2. Scholarship application and self-introduction (장학생 지원서 및 자기소개서.hwp); 3. Scholarship recommendation list (장학생 추천명단.xlsx). The contents of these attachments were not read for this translation.
